enchantments.tooltip: Resistance +5: Passive: +5 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Perform +14: Passive: +14 Competence bonus to the Perform skill.
Sonic Guard: This item blasts those that attack the wearer, causing 1d6 sonic damage on a successful melee attack.
Anthem: When equipped by a character with Bard levels, this item begins to hum an inspiring tune. Your bard songs regenerate slowly over time.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
